title: Fridolin config.json
description: The bridge's configuration, version 2, as docs/CONFIGURATION.md describes it. A file without "version", or with null, is version 1, which may also have the retired keys model, work_dir and brains. Every key is optional: the bridge fills in a default for each one left out. Keys are added in later versions without a new version; one renamed, removed or given another meaning comes with a new version.

_comment.description: A note for whoever reads the file; the bridge keeps it as it is.

version.description: The version of this file, written by the bridge on every save; absent or null is 1.

allowed_numbers.description: Phone numbers, with the country code, that may DM the bridge.

allow_any_dm.description: true lets anyone DM while allowed_numbers is empty; unset or false lets nobody.

allowed_groups.description: Group JIDs (…@g.us) the bridge answers in.

group_members.description: Who in an allowed group reaches its brain: by group JID, which allowed_groups must list too, the members' phone numbers, or ["*"] for every member.

triggers.description: Keywords that address the bridge in a group: a string matches anywhere, an object can say where.

claude_path.description: The Claude Code CLI; "claude" looks it up on PATH.

agent_provider.description: The CLI for new brain runs; empty defaults to claude. Changes apply to the next run.

codex_path.description: The Codex CLI; empty defaults to codex on PATH.

codex_model.description: The model for all Codex runs; empty defaults to gpt-6.1-sol.

codex_effort.description: Codex reasoning effort; empty defaults to high.

data_dir.description: The bridge's own data: bridge.db, media, tokens. Needs a restart.

max_chunk_size.description: The most characters in one outgoing message; 0 is the default, 3900.

max_media_mb.description: The largest attachment downloaded, in MB; 0 is the default, 100.

brain_model.description: The model brains use unless they name their own; empty uses the CLI's default.

disallowed_tools.description: Passed to the CLI as --disallowed-tools; brains can override it.

run_timeout_minutes.description: Stops a run that takes longer; 0 lets it run as long as it takes. Default 30.

max_concurrent_runs.description: How many Claude runs may go at once, all brains together; 0 for no limit. Default 2.

child_env_passthrough.description: Variables of the bridge's environment that brains get too.

http_listen.description: The dashboard's and the script API's address, on loopback only, or "off". Needs a restart.

brain_mode.description: Retired: brains always run. false is refused; the bridge writes true, for an older version rolled back to.

brain_dirs.description: The brain folders added in the dashboard, each with the brain.json you approved.

moved_from.description: Where the folder lives on its home machine, while a core move keeps it in the volume; the move back brings it home.

enabled.description: Runs brains in sandbox-exec on macOS, in bubblewrap in the fridolin-core container; refused elsewhere.

include_secret_files.description: Also uploads .env files, private keys and tokens from brain folders. Default false.

voice.description: Voice mode of the Plaud Sync app: spoken questions go to voice_brain, and the answer is read aloud on the phone. Needs phone_upload.

voice_brain.description: The brain that answers voice questions; empty is the brain that handles DMs.

voice_quiet.description: The answer to a voice question goes to the phone only, not also to WhatsApp.

require_token.description: Default true. Turning it off needs a restart; turning it on applies at once.

core.description: The containerized core. Off by default.

enabled.description: Joins the tailnet as its own device (tsnet). Default false. Needs a restart.

hostname.description: The core's name on the tailnet, one DNS label. Default fridolin-core. Needs a restart.

enabled.description: Takes and renews the core lease in the vault bucket. Default false. Needs a restart.

stale_seconds.description: Default 1200; must be more than renew_seconds. Needs a restart.

vault.description: The tiered vault in Backblaze B2. Off by default.

endpoint.description: The S3 endpoint's host name. Default s3.eu-central-003.backblazeb2.com.

b2_daily_budget.description: Class B and Class C transactions a day each that doctor and the dashboard measure B2 use against, warning at 70%. Default 2000.

targets.description: Backup targets besides the cloud: restic repositories in folders on nodes (docs/VAULT.md, Node targets). They run whether or not the vault is on.

folder.description: An absolute path on the node, in its own spelling.

hourly.description: A snapshot each hour besides the nightly one.

include_data_dir.description: The nightly snapshot takes the data dir too, less the brain folders that do not choose the target.

window_hours.description: How old the last snapshot may be before doctor warns. Default 26.

nodes.description: The port nodes connect to. Off by default.

enabled.description: Accept node connections. Needs a restart.

policy.description: Limits on what brains do without asking.

housekeeping.description: The job that finds what the bridge and its children left running and stops what is the bridge's own.

enabled.description: Run on the schedule. Default true.

dry_run.description: Only report what it would stop or remove. Default true.

cpu_percent.description: CPU, in percent of one core, that makes a process heavy. Default 80.

rss_mb.description: Resident memory in MB that makes a process heavy. Default 2048.

min_age_minutes.description: Processes younger than this are left alone. Default 60.

schedules.description: The scheduled agents of every brain (docs/BRAINS.md, Scheduled agents): whether they run on their schedules, how they are spread, and how much of their history and logs is kept.

enabled.description: Run the agents on their schedules; Run now works either way. Default true.

jitter_minutes.description: Spread each agent's runs by a fixed offset within this many minutes, unless it sets its own. Default 2.

keep_days.description: Drop runs older than this from the history (each agent keeps its newest). Default 30.

keep_runs.description: Keep at most this many runs of each agent. Default 100.

max_total_mb.description: Drop the oldest runs of all agents until their logs take no more than this. Default 200.

max_log_kb.description: Cut one run's log at this size. Default 1024.

model.description: Retired in version 2: version 1's model, which becomes brain_model while that is empty.

work_dir.description: Retired in version 2: the folder classic mode ran in.

brains.description: Retired in version 2: inline brains, refused unless the list is empty.

bucket.description: A B2 bucket name: 6 to 63 lower-case letters, digits and -, not starting with b2-.

absolute_path.description: An absolute path, or one that starts with ~/.

phone_number.description: 6 to 15 digits with the country code, written as people write a number: a +, spaces, dashes, dots or brackets, or as its …@s.whatsapp.net JID.
